summary: Secret-council Simic cheat: vote for cards or a free monster, then win one combat with Reins of Power.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Círdan's secret council, Illusion of Choice, and the whole vote package are the plan.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Reins of Power, Elrond, Twincast, and Kiora close by using other people's creatures.

tags.name: group hug
tags.reason: Shared dumps and council draws give the table cards and permanents on purpose.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Heavy one- and two-mana ramp exists to put Círdan out on turn three.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: The deck develops a monster board and wins in combat rather than combo.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: Fight spells and a few counters protect the dump, but answering is not the main plan.

tags.name: stax
tags.reason: Concordant Crossroads and Grothama change combat rules without locking the table.
